prompt:
Research the official rate limits of the public GitHub REST API for unauthenticated and authenticated requests. Cite the GitHub documentation page and quote the numbers.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the GitHub documentation, here are the official rate limits for the GitHub REST API:

For unauthenticated requests:
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "The primary rate limit for unauthenticated requests is 60 requests per hour." | CLAIM: Unauthenticated API requests are limited to 60 per hour

For authenticated requests using personal access tokens:
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "All of these requests count towards your personal rate limit of 5,000 requests per hour." | CLAIM: Authenticated requests using personal access tokens have a limit of 5,000 requests per hour

For authenticated requests via GitHub Apps or OAuth apps owned by GitHub Enterprise Cloud organizations:
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "Requests made on your behalf by a GitHub App that is owned by a GitHub Enterprise Cloud organization have a higher rate limit of 15,000 requests per hour." | CLAIM: GitHub Apps owned by Enterprise Cloud organizations have a limit of 15,000 requests per hour

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "Similarly, requests made on your behalf by a OAuth app that is owned or approved by a GitHub Enterprise Cloud organization have a higher rate limit of 15,000 requests per hour if you are a member of the GitHub Enterprise Cloud organization." | CLAIM: OAuth apps owned by Enterprise Cloud organizations have a limit of 15,000 requests per hour for members

The documentation clearly shows that authenticated requests provide significantly higher rate limits compared to unauthenticated requests, with standard authenticated users getting 5,000 requests per hour versus only 60 requests per hour for unauthenticated users.
